## `0146` — F1.BehavioralObservation: discriminated-union typing over four sub-modalities (mouse_trajectory, keystroke_timing, scroll_cadence, pointer_dwell); second F1 modality landing; touch_gesture deferred to sub-RFC

- **Status:** accepted.
- **Date:** 2026-05-23.
- **Context:** Per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) Domain Pack v0.1 timeline (mês 2 P0 sequencial) and [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 3 (discriminated-union pattern cascades to BehavioralObservation, AttestationObservation, BrowserObservation), this entry records the **second F1 modality** landing: BehavioralObservation. Pre-condition discharged: F1.NetworkObservation merged at [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) (PR #164) + CIC-IDS adapter pattern established at [`§0145`](#0145--cic-ids-2017-adapter-lands-first-public-adversarial-ingestion-source-integrated-18-aggregate-coverage-empirically-confirmed-flow_record_summary-omq-candidate-surfaced) (PR #165). Constitutional framing: discriminated union (proto3 oneof) over **four sub-modalities** — `mouse_trajectory`, `keystroke_timing`, `scroll_cadence`, `pointer_dwell`. touch_gesture deferred per §0146 (b) as mobile-specific anticipated sub-RFC.

- **Decision:** Five proto-definitions land in `schemas/events/v1/` under flat-directory convention per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) precedent: `behavioral_observation.proto` (envelope) + `behavioral_mouse_trajectory.proto` + `behavioral_keystroke_timing.proto` + `behavioral_scroll_cadence.proto` + `behavioral_pointer_dwell.proto`.

  Constitutional discipline applied at proto-definition layer (parallel to [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) NetworkObservation):

  - **actor_ref per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted)** — declared on envelope; optional (empty = unattributed).
  - **collector_ref per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) (e)** — declared on envelope; phenomenon-vs-record reconciliation slot.
  - **Content-addressable BLAKE3 per §2.1** — property of canonical Marshal+Hash pipeline (not per-record field).
  - **Hash-reconstructible per F6 anticipated contract** — zero references to external state in any sub-modality proto.
  - **Paired-dimension exclusion per [§2.6 BC3](../charter/constitutional-charter.md#26-evidential-independence-integrity)** — BehavioralObservation + its 4 sub-modality types declare neither `confidence` nor `evidential_independence`; structurally excluded from `validatePairedDimensionCommitment` per [`§0140`](#0140--canonical-serialization-contract-revision-paireddimension-marshallingboundary-enforcement-corrected-allowpartial-false-no-op-for-proto3-acknowledged-explicit-canonical-package-check-installed). Mechanized by existing `TestPairedDimensionSubjectSet_StructuralDetection` (auto-picks-up new `behavioral-observation` messageFactory registration).
  - **Privacy-preserving sub-modality design** — `keystroke_timing` carries TIMING distributions only (flight + dwell intervals); NO key codes, character codes, or input content recorded. `pointer_dwell` carries `element_class` structural identifier (CSS-selector-class or equivalent), NOT element content or user-typed input. These are structural design choices to prevent the sub-modality from becoming a covert channel for content exfiltration via Cat I observation.

  **New envelope field: `session_ref` (string)** — optional producer-supplied identifier of the session context. Per §0146 (d): producer-supplied identifier (parallel to actor_ref shape, NOT a substrate-verifiable BLAKE3 reference like `IngestionEvent.primary_event_hash`). Choice rationale: inception-phase simplicity over substrate-verifiability; substrate verifiability can be added later via enrichment record (a paired Cat I observation linking BehavioralObservation hash to a specific DeclaredSession hash) if F3 pressure surfaces. The string form preserves the producer's existing session identifier (e.g. session UUID from browser SDK) without requiring producers to compute substrate hashes at observation time.

- **Constitutional review:** No Charter prose modified. No Charter invariant amended. No new Charter invariant. Each invariant consumed but not modified: §2.1 (substrate immutability inherited; BehavioralObservation is Cat I primary), §2.2 (Cat I primary observation per entity-model.md §Category I), §2.3 (provenance chain terminates at Cat I primaries — BehavioralObservation IS such a primary), §2.6 BC3 (paired-dimension subject set excludes observation records — confirmed by structural detection in `validatePairedDimensionCommitment`).

  Falsifiability discipline: round-trip determinism per sub-modality mechanized by `TestBehavioralObservation_RoundTripPerModality`; oneof discriminator hash separation by `TestBehavioralObservation_OneofExhaustiveness`; actor_ref discipline by `TestBehavioralObservation_ActorRefDiscipline`; session_ref discipline (NEW envelope field) by `TestBehavioralObservation_SessionRefDiscipline`; collector_ref discipline by `TestBehavioralObservation_CollectorRefDiscipline`; structural paired-dimension exclusion by the existing `TestPairedDimensionSubjectSet_StructuralDetection` auto-picking-up the new messageFactory registration.

- **Consequences:**
  - Five proto-definitions land in `schemas/events/v1/`: `behavioral_observation.proto`, `behavioral_mouse_trajectory.proto`, `behavioral_keystroke_timing.proto`, `behavioral_scroll_cadence.proto`, `behavioral_pointer_dwell.proto`.
  - Five generated Go pb.go files (gitignored; CI regenerates via `make generate`).
  - `messageFactory` in `corpus_test.go` extends with `behavioral-observation` entry.
  - New focused test file `behavioral_observation_test.go` covering round-trip per modality, oneof exhaustiveness, actor_ref + session_ref + collector_ref discipline.
  - Golden corpus extends with five fixtures: `behavioral-observation-{minimal, mouse-trajectory, keystroke-timing, scroll-cadence, pointer-dwell}.{json, bin, hash}`.
  - `services/ingestion/Makefile` `generate` target adds the five new proto files to the explicit enumeration.
  - **Schemas-evolution event per canonical-serialization-contract §Schemas-Evolution Events boundary** — five new proto message types added; corpus regenerated; goldens committed. No existing proto modified; no breaking change to existing corpus.
  - **Two of four F1 modalities now landed (Network + Behavioral).** Per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) trigger for authentication-class typing OMQ: "when F1 has three modalities stable" — still **NOT triggered**; opens when AttestationObservation lands (likely mês 2-3 per §0143 timeline).
  - **F4 authentication-class OMQ remains structurally pending per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 2.** BehavioralObservation is largely client-witnessed (browser SDK observes user input; producer-attested unless cryptographic attestation chain present). The authentication-class distinction (server-authenticated / client-attested / client-witnessed) becomes empirically forced once AttestationObservation lands; until then, observations of all three classes coexist without explicit typing — operationally tolerated by structural design (each sub-modality carries its own observation-source semantics implicitly).
  - **Phenomenon-vs-record reconciliation OMQ remains structurally pending per [`§0145`](#0145--cic-ids-2017-adapter-lands-first-public-adversarial-ingestion-source-integrated-18-aggregate-coverage-empirically-confirmed-flow_record_summary-omq-candidate-surfaced) Consequence.** BehavioralObservation introduces a fourth `collector_ref` namespace (`browser-sdk:v1`, `synthetic-behavioral-gen:v0`, `honeypot-behavioral-collector:hp-01`). When second BehavioralObservation source emits records under distinct collector_ref, the OMQ surface advances; not yet at committee-resolution threshold.
  - **Methodological observation 1 — Discriminated-union pattern cascades cleanly from NetworkObservation to BehavioralObservation.** [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 3 predicted the pattern would extend; this landing confirms it works without modification. Envelope (observed_at + actor_ref + collector_ref + oneof modality) is the canonical Cat I observation shape for F1; BehavioralObservation adds session_ref to the envelope as a behavioral-specific extension. **Pattern validated for further extension to AttestationObservation + BrowserObservation; envelope fields may diverge per modality (e.g., BrowserObservation may add user_agent_ref) without breaking the discriminated-union discipline.**
  - **Methodological observation 2 — Sub-modality count is a structural choice, not a symmetry requirement.** NetworkObservation lands with 5 sub-modalities (§0144); BehavioralObservation lands with 4 (this entry). The asymmetry is intentional: touch_gesture (mobile-specific behavioral surface) is structurally distinct from mouse/keyboard/scroll/dwell in deployment context, and its inclusion would force the proto to model mobile-vs-desktop discrimination across all four other sub-modalities. **Deferred to a future sub-RFC `ontology-revision-behavioral-touch-gesture-modality` when mobile deployment surfaces empirical pressure.** Pattern parallel to [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) (c) AttestationObservation cascade anticipation. **Future F1 modalities should choose sub-modality count by structural justification, not by pattern symmetry.**
  - **Methodological observation 3 — Privacy-preserving sub-modality design is part of Cat I discipline.** `keystroke_timing` carries timing distributions ONLY (no key codes, no content); `pointer_dwell` carries `element_class` structural identifier (no element content). The structural design prevents the sub-modality from becoming a covert exfiltration channel via Cat I observation. **Future F1 modalities collecting human-input surface should follow the same structural-not-content-bearing discipline; content-bearing observation would require explicit decision-log entry justifying the deviation and would likely require a paired privacy enrichment record (out-of-scope for this PR).**
  - **Methodological observation 4 — `session_ref` introduced as producer-supplied identifier (parallel to actor_ref), not substrate-verifiable hash (parallel to primary_event_hash).** Choice rationale documented at Decision section above. **Establishes precedent for future envelope-level context fields: producer-supplied identifiers when the field is identity/context-shaped; BLAKE3-hash references when the field anchors a specific substrate record.** A future enrichment record may pair BehavioralObservation hash to specific DeclaredSession hash if F3 pressure surfaces; the enrichment shape would parallel IngestionEvent.

- **Supersession:** No prior decision-log entry superseded. Second F1 modality landing under Domain Pack v0.1; pattern cascade from [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) NetworkObservation operationally validated.

## `0147` — F1.AttestationObservation: discriminated-union over 5 attestation protocols; third F1 modality lands; F4 authentication-class typing OMQ trigger fires per §0143

- **Status:** accepted.
- **Date:** 2026-05-23.
- **Context:** Per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) Domain Pack v0.1 timeline (mês 2-3 P0 sequencial) and [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 3 (discriminated-union pattern cascades across F1 modalities), this entry records the **third F1 modality** landing: AttestationObservation. Pre-condition discharged: F1.NetworkObservation merged at [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) (PR #164) + F1.BehavioralObservation merged at [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) (PR #166).

  Constitutional framing: discriminated union (proto3 oneof) over **five sub-modalities**, one per attestation protocol: `apple_pat`, `google_privacy_pass`, `cloudflare_turnstile`, `webauthn_assertion`, `fido2_attestation`. Five is justified by 5 structurally-distinct attestation protocols, each with distinct cryptographic ceremony, verification path, and standardization body. Per [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) Methodological observation 2 (sub-modality count is structural choice, not symmetry requirement): symmetry with NetworkObservation's 5 is coincidental, not enforced.

  **OMQ trigger event:** F1 now has **3/3 modalities stable** (Network + Behavioral + Attestation). Per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) anticipated-OMQs table, the **authentication-class typing OMQ trigger fires now**: AttestationObservation introduces the third modality, exposing the structural distinction between server-authenticated (NetworkObservation collector-witnessed at gateway), client-attested (AttestationObservation with cryptographic chain), and client-witnessed (BehavioralObservation with no attestation chain). The structural distinction is empirically forced — different observation classes carry different verifiability properties; the substrate lacks a structural surface to record this distinction at the envelope level. Per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 2 (anticipate ≠ pre-resolve), the OMQ resolution is NOT pre-empted in this proto landing — proposed for separate `ontology-revision-authentication-class-typing` RFC as a follow-on entry.

- **Decision:** Six proto-definitions land in `schemas/events/v1/` under flat-directory convention per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) precedent: `attestation_observation.proto` (envelope) + `attestation_apple_pat.proto` + `attestation_google_privacy_pass.proto` + `attestation_cloudflare_turnstile.proto` + `attestation_webauthn_assertion.proto` + `attestation_fido2.proto`.

  Constitutional discipline applied at proto-definition layer (parallel to [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) + [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc)):

  - **actor_ref per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted)** — declared on envelope; optional.
  - **session_ref per [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) (d)** — declared on envelope; producer-supplied identifier.
  - **collector_ref per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) (e)** — declared on envelope.
  - **Content-addressable BLAKE3 per §2.1** — property of canonical Marshal+Hash pipeline.
  - **Hash-reconstructible per F6 anticipated contract** — zero external state references.
  - **Paired-dimension exclusion per [§2.6 BC3](../charter/constitutional-charter.md#26-evidential-independence-integrity)** — AttestationObservation + its 5 sub-modality types declare neither `confidence` nor `evidential_independence`; structurally excluded from `validatePairedDimensionCommitment`. Mechanized by existing `TestPairedDimensionSubjectSet_StructuralDetection` auto-picking-up new `attestation-observation` messageFactory registration.
  - **Privacy-preserving Cat I design per [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) Methodological observation 3, extended at attestation surface:** credential identifiers committed as BLAKE3 hashes (NOT raw bytes) — token-hash fields for Apple PAT / Google PP / Cloudflare Turnstile response tokens; credential-id-hash fields for WebAuthn + FIDO2 credentials; challenge-hash for challenge-response anchoring; user-handle-hash for WebAuthn userHandle; clientDataJSON-hash for WebAuthn clientDataJSON. Verification-load-bearing artifacts (WebAuthn authenticatorData + signature; FIDO2 attestationObject) committed as raw bytes so substrate-side forensic re-verification remains possible. **Pattern: hash credential identifiers; preserve verification-load-bearing cryptographic artifacts as bytes.** Trade-off explicitly: substrate-side forensic verifiability preserved; raw token redeemability NOT committed (operator may retain raw out-of-band).

- **Constitutional review:** No Charter prose modified. No Charter invariant amended. No new Charter invariant. Each invariant consumed but not modified: §2.1 (Cat I substrate immutability), §2.2 (Cat I primary observation), §2.3 (provenance chain terminus), §2.6 BC3 (paired-dimension exclusion).

  Falsifiability discipline: round-trip determinism per sub-modality mechanized by `TestAttestationObservation_RoundTripPerModality`; oneof discriminator hash separation by `TestAttestationObservation_OneofExhaustiveness`; hash-field participation by `TestAttestationObservation_HashFieldsParticipateInHash` (different token_hash → different envelope hash); collector_ref discipline by `TestAttestationObservation_CollectorRefDiscipline`; paired-dimension exclusion by existing `TestPairedDimensionSubjectSet_StructuralDetection` auto-pickup.

- **Consequences:**
  - Six proto-definitions land in `schemas/events/v1/`: `attestation_observation.proto`, `attestation_apple_pat.proto`, `attestation_google_privacy_pass.proto`, `attestation_cloudflare_turnstile.proto`, `attestation_webauthn_assertion.proto`, `attestation_fido2.proto`.
  - Six generated Go pb.go files (gitignored; CI regenerates).
  - `messageFactory` extends with `attestation-observation` entry.
  - New focused test file `attestation_observation_test.go` (4 tests).
  - Golden corpus extends with six fixtures: `attestation-observation-{minimal, apple-pat, google-privacy-pass, cloudflare-turnstile, webauthn-assertion, fido2}.{json, bin, hash}`.
  - Makefile `generate` target adds the six new proto files.
  - **Schemas-evolution event** per canonical-serialization-contract §Schemas-Evolution Events boundary.
  - **§0143 F4 authentication-class typing OMQ trigger FIRES.** F1 now has 3/3 modalities stable. The OMQ moves from anticipated-pending to **trigger-fired-pending-resolution**. Per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) anticipated-OMQs table disposition: "Propose opening separate `ontology-revision-authentication-class-typing` RFC". **This entry's Methodological observation 1 records the trigger-firing as a milestone; the separate RFC is the next workitem after this PR merges.**
  - **3/3 F1 modalities now stable; only BrowserObservation remains for full F1 atlas.** Per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) timeline (mês 2-3), F1.BrowserObservation may also need sub-RFC for 5 distinct surface modalities (canvas, WebGL, font, CDP markers, header order) — pattern parallel to this entry. Anticipated.
  - **Phenomenon-vs-record reconciliation OMQ** ([`§0145`](#0145--cic-ids-2017-adapter-lands-first-public-adversarial-ingestion-source-integrated-18-aggregate-coverage-empirically-confirmed-flow_record_summary-omq-candidate-surfaced) Consequence): collector_ref namespace extends with attestation sources (`browser-sdk:v1`, `honeypot-attestation-collector:hp-01`); not yet at committee-resolution threshold.
  - **Methodological observation 1 — F4 authentication-class OMQ trigger-fired event recorded.** The OMQ was anticipated in [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) and re-noted as pending in [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) + [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc); the trigger fires here per [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) criterion (F1 has three modalities stable). Anticipated → trigger-fired → resolved-via-separate-RFC is the canonical anticipated-OMQ lifecycle.
  - **Methodological observation 2 — Privacy-preserving Cat I design extends to cryptographic attestation surface.** [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) established the principle for human-input surface (keystroke_timing carries no key codes; pointer_dwell carries no element content); this entry extends it to attestation surface (credential identifiers as hashes; raw tokens not committed). **Pattern generalizes: when a Cat I observation could carry exfiltratable content if naively raw-bytes-recorded, prefer hash-form for identifiers + raw-bytes-form for verification-load-bearing artifacts.** Trade-off explicit: substrate-side forensic verifiability preserved on the verification path; substrate-side raw-token redeemability NOT committed.
  - **Methodological observation 3 — Discriminated-union pattern cascades cleanly for the third consecutive F1 modality.** [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 3 predicted; [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) Methodological observation 1 confirmed for second; this entry confirms for third. **Pattern thoroughly validated; BrowserObservation will follow the same shape without further re-deliberation.** Envelope fields: observed_at + actor_ref + session_ref + collector_ref + oneof modality. Sub-modality count: choose by structural justification.

- **Supersession:** No prior decision-log entry superseded. Third F1 modality landing; pattern cascade complete for 3 of 4 modalities; F4 authentication-class OMQ trigger fires for separate RFC follow-on.

## `0149` — Authentication-class typing OMQ substantive deliberation complete; Phase 2-5 in evidence file; recommendation = Candidate α (envelope enum field); resolution pending committee approval

- **Status:** accepted (substantive deliberation Phase 2-5 records committed; recommendation issued; resolution is the next decision-log entry pending committee approval).
- **Date:** 2026-05-24.
- **Context:** [`§0148`](#0148--ontologyrevision-rfc-opens-authenticationclass-typing-omq-formally-registered-in-entitymodelmd-six-candidate-forms-enumerated-for-discussionphase-deliberation) opened the authentication-class typing OMQ for committee deliberation with 6 candidate forms enumerated at framing-PR phase. This entry records the **substantive deliberation closure**: Phase 2 per-candidate × per-axis analysis + Phase 3 epistemic-skill review + Phase 4 synthesis (6 findings) + Phase 5 recommendation. **Resolution is NOT in this entry** — per the canonical OMQ lifecycle codified at [`§0147`](#0147--f1attestationobservation-discriminatedunion-over-5-attestation-protocols-third-f1-modality-lands-f4-authenticationclass-typing-omq-trigger-fires-per-0143) Methodological observation 1 (anticipated → trigger-fired → opening-for-resolution → resolution), this is the deliberation-closure stage with recommendation; the resolution stage produces the entity-model.md OMQ closure + proto changes + corpus regeneration in a separate PR pending committee approval.

  Substantive deliberation produced 6 findings in evidence file Phase 4 (paraphrased here):
  - Finding 1: γ + ε rejected at posture-axis (operator-convention-only candidates have lower epistemic yield per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 1).
  - Finding 2: β rejected at Charter-cost + retrofit axes (subtype hierarchy not inception-phase aligned per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted) Q2 deferral discipline).
  - Finding 3: α survives all axes with smallest cost surface.
  - Finding 4: δ is α's structural alternative with stronger forward-compat at consumer-indirection cost.
  - Finding 5: ζ has maximum expressivity but redundancy ambiguity.
  - Finding 6: Inception-phase posture favors α with reversal conditions documented.

- **Decision:** **Recommendation = Candidate α — Envelope enum field.** Add `authentication_class` proto3 enum field (UNKNOWN / SERVER_AUTHENTICATED / CLIENT_ATTESTED / CLIENT_WITNESSED) to each of the 4 F1 envelopes (NetworkObservation, BehavioralObservation, AttestationObservation, BrowserObservation). Recommended envelope field placement: at the END of envelope field numbers (after the oneof) to preserve binary backward-compat for existing records.

  Recommendation is for committee approval; resolution will:

  1. Add `authentication_class` proto3 enum to all 4 F1 envelopes.
  2. Schemas-evolution event per canonical-serialization-contract.
  3. entity-model.md §Open Modeling Questions F4 entry moves to §Resolved Modeling Questions.
  4. Corpus regeneration + golden file refresh across 18+ affected fixtures (+ new BrowserObservation fixtures when that modality lands).
  5. Reversal conditions documented per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted) + [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults) pattern (4 reversal triggers named in evidence Phase 5).

  Adoption is contingent on committee approval at the resolution decision-log entry; this entry's recommendation is structurally Phase 5 of the deliberation, NOT the OMQ resolution.

- **Constitutional review:** No Charter prose modified by this entry (deliberation closure with recommendation only). The recommendation, if adopted at resolution, requires NO Charter amendment per Phase 2 α-analysis: field is structural property of Cat I observation; inherits §2.1 immutability without amendment; §3 N1 satisfied (enum values name verification channel, not truth claim); §2.3 BC4 (Identity tiers resolved per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted)) not touched.

  Falsifiability discipline: deliberation-phase-5-complete predicate is structurally observable — evidence file contains Phase 2 (per-candidate × per-axis analysis), Phase 3 (epistemic-skill review), Phase 4 (6 numbered findings), Phase 5 (recommendation with justification + recommended enum specification + recommended field placement + recommended reversal conditions). Resolution-phase falsifiability discipline is per-candidate; for α specifically: "every F1 envelope record carries one of 4 enum values" is substrate-replay-checkable post-resolution.

- **Consequences:**
  - [`docs/rfcs/discussion/authentication-class-typing-evidence.md`](../rfcs/discussion/authentication-class-typing-evidence.md) extended with Phase 2 (per-candidate × per-axis analysis covering 6 axes × 6 candidates) + Phase 3 (epistemic-skill review on 4 surviving candidates) + Phase 4 (6 findings) + Phase 5 (recommendation with recommended enum spec + placement + reversal conditions).
  - [`docs/rfcs/draft/ontology-revision-authentication-class-typing.md`](../rfcs/draft/ontology-revision-authentication-class-typing.md) Status remains `discussion`; substantive deliberation complete inside the evidence file; RFC status advances to `accepted (recommendation: α)` at resolution PR.
  - **No proto changes in this PR.** No corpus changes. No schemas-evolution event. No entity-model.md revision (OMQ remains open until resolution).
  - **Methodological observation 1 — OMQ lifecycle stage `deliberation-closure-with-recommendation` codified.** Distinct from `opening-for-resolution` ([`§0148`](#0148--ontologyrevision-rfc-opens-authenticationclass-typing-omq-formally-registered-in-entitymodelmd-six-candidate-forms-enumerated-for-discussionphase-deliberation)) and from `resolution` (next entry). The deliberation-closure stage produces the analytical content + recommendation; the resolution stage produces the structural commitment + proto/entity-model changes. **Pattern: ontology-revision RFCs may have 4-stage decision-log lifecycle (anticipated → trigger-fired → opening-for-resolution → deliberation-closure-with-recommendation → resolution) when the OMQ requires substantial committee deliberation.** Five distinct stages in total; some entries may merge stages (e.g., quick-resolve OMQs may combine opening + closure + resolution in single entry). The 4-stage decomposition is justified when each stage has substantial structural content warranting its own auditable boundary.
  - **Methodological observation 2 — γ + ε rejection at posture-axis demonstrates posture-statement load-bearing function.** Phase 1 posture statement (in evidence file) explicitly downweighted operator-convention-only candidates per [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) Methodological observation 1 (strong-typing epistemic-yield argument). Phase 4 Finding 1 enacts the posture by rejecting γ + ε pre-Phase-3. **Pattern: framing-PR posture statements are not advisory; they are operationally binding on candidate survival.** Future ontology-revision RFCs should treat posture statements as load-bearing — candidates that fail posture axes are rejected before downstream phases consume effort.
  - **Methodological observation 3 — β rejection at inception-phase axis demonstrates [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted) Q2 + [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults) F2 conservative-defaults bundle precedent.** β's structural richness is acknowledged but its Charter-cost + retrofit-cost burden is incompatible with inception-phase posture per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted) (defer multi-tier complexity when single-tier suffices). **Pattern: inception-phase posture rejects structurally-richer candidates in favor of simpler forms with documented reversal conditions.** Reversal conditions are the bridge: candidate β remains a viable revisitation path under named triggers (R-α-2 in evidence Phase 5).
  - **Methodological observation 4 — Anti-marketing watchlist surfaces as enum-extensibility constraint.** Per Phase 3 anti-marketing review: future enum expansion that introduces aspirational-noun-shaped value names (per the [`anti-marketing`](../../.claude/skills/enforcement/anti-marketing/SKILL.md) watchlist) would breach watchlist discipline. **Pattern: enum extensibility must remain on structural-channel-naming axis (e.g., `MULTI_FACTOR_AUTHENTICATED`, `HARDWARE_ATTESTED`).** This constraint records in the recommendation as a forward-looking discipline for future enum value additions.

- **Supersession:** No prior decision-log entry superseded. F4 OMQ moves from opening-for-resolution ([`§0148`](#0148--ontologyrevision-rfc-opens-authenticationclass-typing-omq-formally-registered-in-entitymodelmd-six-candidate-forms-enumerated-for-discussionphase-deliberation)) to deliberation-closure-with-recommendation (this entry); resolution pending committee approval at next decision-log entry.

## `0152` — F3 inference layer opens: `cdp_marker_density_v1` signature for AutomationGroup; first Camada A canonical-aberta signature lands; new signatures/ package establishes F3 surface

- **Status:** accepted.
- **Date:** 2026-05-24.
- **Context:** Per Domain Pack v0.1 [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) timeline (mês 4-5 P0 sequencial), F3 signature engines work begins after F1 atlas closure ([`§0151`](#0151--f1browserobservation-fourth-and-final-f1-modality-lands-f1-atlas-complete-44-inherits-authentication_class-natively-per-0150-no-retrofit-discriminatedunion-pattern-4-validated)). F3 is the **inference layer** — the Cat III formation logic that consumes Cat I observations + Cat II constructs and produces formation candidates that feed the existing lifecycle plumbing (form-* CLIs landed at §0086-§0117).

  Per §0143 RFC: "F3 — minimum viable signature engines para BehavioralCluster e AutomationGroup primeiro". This entry records the first F3 signature: `cdp_marker_density_v1` — a Camada A canonical-aberta signature recognizing AutomationGroup formation candidates via Chrome DevTools Protocol marker density at the BrowserObservation surface.

  This is the **first F3 work** establishing the structural surface. New `services/ingestion/internal/signatures/` package opens with the Signature interface + FormationCandidate type + cdp_marker_density_v1 implementation.

- **Decision:** New package `services/ingestion/internal/signatures/` lands with:

  - **`signatures.go`** — package interface: `Signature` (Name + Subtype + EvaluateBrowser); `BrowserSignature` marker interface; `FormationCandidate` (SignatureName + HypothesisSubtype + ActorRefs + SourceHashes + EvidenceCount + ConfidenceHint); `HypothesisSubtype` enum mirroring §0010 Q2-A.2 (4 subtypes: AutomationGroup + BehavioralCluster + CampaignHypothesis + CoordinationRing); MVP scope (this PR): AutomationGroup only.

  - **`cdp_marker_density.go`** — first signature implementation. Stateless. Threshold-based (default 2; configurable). Per-actor aggregation across observation window. Skips observations without cdp_marker modality (other modalities out-of-scope). Skips unattributed observations (no actor_ref anchor for AutomationGroup per ontology). Source hashes via canonical.MarshalAndHash + sorted ascending per [`§0139`](#0139--canonicalserializationcontract-revision-blake3hashlist-elementshape-discipline-generalized-from-two-influencestorage-fields-to-the-full-canonicalformloadbearing-set) hash-list discipline. ConfidenceHint linearly scaled in [0.5, 0.9]; capped at 0.9 per [§3 N1](../charter/constitutional-charter.md#3-non-goals) (substrate never asserts certainty).

  - **`cdp_marker_density_test.go`** — 10 focused tests covering: below-threshold no-emit, at-threshold one-candidate, multi-actor candidates ordered alphabetically, aggregation-across-window, source-hash ascending order per §0139, unattributed-observation skip, non-cdp-modality skip, custom-threshold override, context-cancellation, confidence-hint cap at 0.9.

  Constitutional discipline applied at F3 layer:

  - **[§3 N3](../charter/constitutional-charter.md#3-non-goals) no autonomous irreversible action** — signature engines produce CANDIDATES; do NOT commit formation events directly. Operator (CLI command, scheduled job, manual invocation) consumes candidates and decides whether to commit. Preserves the operator-elected-substrate-commit discipline established at [`§0119`](#0119--cli-orphan-cleanup-audit-symmetry-authscope-rfc-open-question-4-discharged-via-operator-opt-in) + [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults) E1.
  - **[§2.4](../charter/constitutional-charter.md#24-inferential-influence-disclosure) + [`§0021`](#0021--ontology-modeling-question-3-influence-at-projection-vs-substrate-cascadetriggered-from-omq-2-resolution-2-1) substrate-time generation** — signatures surface SourceHashes (Cat I observation hashes that contributed to recognition); orchestrator threads these into formation event's `source_event_hashes` field + declares `influenced_by` chain at commit time per §2.4 BC3. The signature does not declare influence directly; that's the orchestrator's responsibility at the substrate boundary.
  - **[`§0133`](#0133--q3-resolution-candidate--sourcecount-ratio-adopted-26-bc1-operational-specification-discharged-0132-cascade-trigger-fires-q5-transitivityhalf-pregate-opened) Q3-α evidential_independence** — signatures surface EvidenceCount (count of Cat I source hashes); orchestrator uses this for EI computation at commit time per §0133 source-count ratio formula. Signatures do not compute EI directly; that's orchestrator territory at the paired-dimension marshalling boundary per [`§0140`](#0140--canonical-serialization-contract-revision-paireddimension-marshallingboundary-enforcement-corrected-allowpartial-false-no-op-for-proto3-acknowledged-explicit-canonical-package-check-installed).
  - **[`§0139`](#0139--canonicalserializationcontract-revision-blake3hashlist-elementshape-discipline-generalized-from-two-influencestorage-fields-to-the-full-canonicalformloadbearing-set) hash-list element-shape discipline** — SourceHashes sorted ascending lexicographic at candidate-emit time (defense-in-depth; substrate commit-time enforcement remains authoritative).
  - **[`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) Sub-benchmark 1 instrumentation surface** — signature carries Name + Subtype, enabling per-signature × per-subtype × per-fonte instrumentation when orchestrator wires it up. MVP focuses on signature shape; instrumentation wiring at orchestrator landing.

  **Camada classification (per §0143 D3):** cdp_marker_density_v1 is **Camada A canonical-aberta** — CDP markers (`navigator.webdriver=true`, `$cdc_*` runtime variables, missing `chrome.runtime`/`chrome.csi`) are well-documented anti-bot detection axes published in the open literature (Selenium / Puppeteer / Playwright detection countermeasures are public knowledge). The signature codifies a public pattern; openness has no adversarial-utility loss.

- **Constitutional review:** No Charter prose modified. No Charter invariant amended. No new Charter invariant. Each invariant consumed but not modified per the discipline mapping above.

  Falsifiability discipline: each signature behavior structurally observable via the test suite. Threshold predicate (`detection_count >= threshold`) mechanically checkable. Source-hash ordering predicate per §0139 mechanically checkable. Confidence-hint cap per §3 N1 mechanically checkable. Per-actor aggregation predicate mechanically checkable.

- **Consequences:**
  - New package `services/ingestion/internal/signatures/` lands with 3 Go files (signatures.go + cdp_marker_density.go + cdp_marker_density_test.go).
  - No proto changes. No corpus regeneration. No schemas-evolution event.
  - **F3 surface opens.** Future signatures land in the same package; new sub-modality signatures (uniform_cadence_v1 for AutomationGroup, behavioral-cluster shared-descriptor for BehavioralCluster, etc.) follow the same Signature interface.
  - **Orchestrator wiring deferred.** This PR provides the signature library; the CLI command (e.g., `cmd/find-automation-group-candidates/`) or scheduled-job orchestrator that consumes signatures + invokes existing `form-automation-group` CLI is follow-on PR work.
  - **Sub-benchmark 1 path forward.** Per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 criterion (first non-trivial demotion under public + synthetic sources, month 3-4): this signature is the first piece of the inference loop that the sub-benchmark exercises. Subsequent work (orchestrator wiring + adapter wiring + actual demotion via Layer B firing) completes the loop. Empirical pressure on the substrate begins when signatures fire against ingested observations from CIC-IDS (`§0145`) + synthetic + honeypot adapters.
  - **Methodological observation 1 — F3 layer separated from Cat III lifecycle plumbing.** The signatures/ package is structurally distinct from hypothesis/ (which carries the lifecycle ops form/promote/demote/dissolve/merge/split per [`§0010`](#0010--ontology-decisions-q2-hypothesissubtypes-q-q4-promotiondemotion-criterion) Q2-A.2 + [`§0011`](#0011--q4-resolution-staged-combination-demotion-criterion-layer-a--deferred-layer-b) Q4 + Layer A/B at [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults)) and from adapters/ (which carries Cat I ingestion per [`§0145`](#0145--cic-ids-2017-adapter-lands-first-public-adversarial-ingestion-source-integrated-18-aggregate-coverage-empirically-confirmed-flow_record_summary-omq-candidate-surfaced) CIC-IDS adapter). **Pattern: 3-layer separation at services/ingestion/internal/: adapters/ (F1 ingestion) + signatures/ (F3 inference) + hypothesis/ (Cat III lifecycle).** F2 Cat II library (per §0143) extends sob pressão de F3; lives in hypothesis/ today (uniform_cadence_v1.go, etc.) and may relocate to a dedicated constructs/ package if pressure surfaces.
  - **Methodological observation 2 — Operator-elected commit discipline preserved at signature/orchestrator boundary.** Signatures produce candidates; orchestrators commit. No autonomous formation. Mirrors the §0141 E1 advisory-like-Layer-A pattern: signature is advisory (produces candidate); orchestrator is authoritative (commits formation). **Pattern: F3 signature engines + orchestrators preserve the operator-elected substrate-commit boundary established for Layer B candidacy.** Future signatures + orchestrators inherit this discipline.
  - **Methodological observation 3 — ConfidenceHint capped at 0.9 per §3 N1 substrate-never-asserts-truth.** No signature emits ConfidenceHint == 1.0 regardless of detection_count. The substrate carries inferential commitments; it does not assert certainty. **Pattern: F3 signature ConfidenceHint values bounded strictly below 1.0; substrate's committed `confidence` per §2.6 paired-dimension inherits the same bound.** Documented as a §3 N1 structural enforcement at the signature layer.
  - **Methodological observation 4 — MVP threshold (2) is conservative per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted) + [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults) F2 conservative-defaults bundle precedent.** Reversal conditions for the threshold:
    - **R-cdp-1: False-positive rate above operator tolerance** — raise threshold or composite with other signatures (e.g., uniform_cadence_v1 AND cdp_marker_density_v1) before formation candidate emission.
    - **R-cdp-2: False-negative rate above operator tolerance** — lower threshold OR introduce per-marker weighting (some markers carry higher confidence than others; current implementation treats them uniformly).
    - **R-cdp-3: New CDP marker types empirically surface** — extend `markers_observed` semantic interpretation; signature may need v2 with weighted marker list.

- **Supersession:** No prior decision-log entry superseded. First F3 signature; opens the inference layer; subsequent F3 work proceeds under ordinary RFC discipline + this entry's pattern.

## `0153` — F3 orchestrator lands: `find-automation-group-candidates` CLI wires signatures/ to substrate-read path; first end-to-end inference loop operational

- **Status:** accepted.
- **Date:** 2026-05-24.
- **Context:** [`§0152`](#0152--f3-inference-layer-opens-cdp_marker_density_v1-signature-for-automationgroup-first-camada-a-canonicalaberta-signature-lands-new-signatures-package-establishes-f3-surface) landed the first F3 signature + signatures/ package. The remaining gap to close the first F3 inference loop end-to-end was the **orchestrator** — the CLI/job that reads observations from substrate, invokes signatures, and surfaces candidates for operator review. This entry records the landing of `cmd/find-automation-group-candidates` — the orchestrator MVP.

  Per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 criterion (first non-trivial demotion under public + synthetic sources, month 3-4): with [`§0145`](#0145--cic-ids-2017-adapter-lands-first-public-adversarial-ingestion-source-integrated-18-aggregate-coverage-empirically-confirmed-flow_record_summary-omq-candidate-surfaced) (CIC-IDS adapter — F1 ingestion), F1 atlas at [`§0144`](#0144--f1networkobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-five-submodalities-tcp_fingerprint-tls_ja4-http2_frame_pattern-dns_pattern-ip_asn-first-protodefinition-landing-under-domain-pack-v01) + [`§0146`](#0146--f1behavioralobservation-discriminatedunion-typing-over-four-submodalities-mouse_trajectory-keystroke_timing-scroll_cadence-pointer_dwell-second-f1-modality-landing-touch_gesture-deferred-to-subrfc) + [`§0147`](#0147--f1attestationobservation-discriminatedunion-over-5-attestation-protocols-third-f1-modality-lands-f4-authenticationclass-typing-omq-trigger-fires-per-0143) + [`§0151`](#0151--f1browserobservation-fourth-and-final-f1-modality-lands-f1-atlas-complete-44-inherits-authentication_class-natively-per-0150-no-retrofit-discriminatedunion-pattern-4-validated) (F1.BrowserObservation), [`§0150`](#0150--f4-authenticationclass-typing-omq-resolution-candidate--adopted-envelope-enum-field-lands-on-3-f1-envelopes-omq-lifecycle-4stage-closes-entitymodelmd-f4-entry-moves-to-resolved-modeling-questions) (authentication_class), [`§0152`](#0152--f3-inference-layer-opens-cdp_marker_density_v1-signature-for-automationgroup-first-camada-a-canonicalaberta-signature-lands-new-signatures-package-establishes-f3-surface) (signature), and now this entry (orchestrator), **the first end-to-end inference loop is operationally complete**:

  ```
  Cat I ingestion (adapter) → substrate commit → substrate read (orchestrator) →
  F3 signature (cdp_marker_density_v1) → FormationCandidate emission →
  operator review → operator-elected form-automation-group commit →
  Layer A/B candidacy → potential demotion
  ```

  Remaining piece for Sub-benchmark 1 firing: actual adversarial pressure with empirically-detected automation patterns producing real candidates that warrant formation + (eventually) demotion. The mechanical loop is now operational; pressure produces the empirical surface for Layer A/B to fire.

- **Decision:** New CLI command `cmd/find-automation-group-candidates/` lands with:

  - **`main.go`** — Orchestrator implementation. Flags: `-db`, `-blobs`, `-threshold` (signature override), `-limit` (max candidates). Read-only substrate access via `substrate.WalkEvents` + `substrate.ReadBlob`. Filter by `MessageType == "ghosttrace.events.v1.BrowserObservation"`. Unmarshal payloads via `proto.Unmarshal`. Invoke `signatures.CDPMarkerDensityV1.EvaluateBrowser`. Emit `emissionEnvelope` (signature name + candidate count + candidates list) as indented JSON to stdout. Summary to stderr (scanned count + candidate count + signature name + threshold).

  - **`main_test.go`** — 3 end-to-end tests: `TestCollectBrowserObservations_EndToEnd` (verifies substrate walk + BrowserObservation filter — IngestionEvent paired records excluded), `TestFullPipeline_EndToEnd` (full pipeline: 3 observations → substrate → walk → signature → JSON output verified), `TestSubtypeName_AllValuesNamed` (subtype enum exhaustive).

  - **Makefile** — `find-automation-group-candidates-build` target added per the existing CLI build-target pattern. Help banner extended.

  Constitutional discipline applied at orchestrator layer:

  - **[§3 N3](../charter/constitutional-charter.md#3-non-goals) no autonomous irreversible action** — orchestrator is READ-ONLY over substrate. NO `AppendPair` invocation. Emits candidates to stdout; does NOT commit formation events. Operator reviews candidates + commits via existing `form-automation-group` CLI per [`§0152`](#0152--f3-inference-layer-opens-cdp_marker_density_v1-signature-for-automationgroup-first-camada-a-canonicalaberta-signature-lands-new-signatures-package-establishes-f3-surface) discipline. Mirrors [`§0119`](#0119--cli-orphan-cleanup-audit-symmetry-authscope-rfc-open-question-4-discharged-via-operator-opt-in) audit-symmetry + [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults) E1 advisory-not-enforcing pattern.

  - **Read-only over substrate; no writeMu contention** — safe to invoke concurrently with ingestion paths. No `AppendPair` means no Substrate-Writer Serialization conflict per concurrency-pattern.md.

  - **Stable JSON output contract** — `candidateJSON` + `emissionEnvelope` types are distinct from `signatures.FormationCandidate` (package-internal) so the CLI's operator-facing output shape is decoupled from internal representation. Source hashes hex-encoded; subtype string-named (not numeric enum value) for operator readability.

  - **Memory footprint O(N) per invocation** — collects all BrowserObservation records in memory before invoking signature. Documented as inception-phase-acceptable; reversal condition R-orch-1 names "substrate size pressure" as trigger for streaming-candidate variant.

- **Constitutional review:** No Charter prose modified. No Charter invariant amended. No new Charter invariant.

  Falsifiability discipline: orchestrator behavior structurally observable via the 3-test end-to-end suite. `TestCollectBrowserObservations_EndToEnd` mechanically verifies BrowserObservation/IngestionEvent filter discipline (paired records must be excluded). `TestFullPipeline_EndToEnd` verifies the complete pipeline produces the expected JSON output shape + values across threshold boundary. `TestSubtypeName_AllValuesNamed` verifies subtype-naming exhaustiveness.

- **Consequences:**
  - New CLI `cmd/find-automation-group-candidates/` operational (`go build` succeeds; `make find-automation-group-candidates-build` produces binary).
  - Makefile + help banner extended.
  - **First end-to-end F3 inference loop operationally complete.** All structural pieces in place: ingestion (§0145 + F1 atlas) → substrate commit → substrate read (this entry) → F3 signature (§0152) → candidate emission. Operator commit + Layer A/B candidacy + demotion already wired via existing form-*/demote-*/Layer-B-evaluation paths.
  - **Sub-benchmark 1 path operational.** Per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 criterion (first non-trivial demotion under public + synthetic sources, month 3-4): the mechanical loop is now end-to-end. Empirical firing requires adversarial pressure with real automation patterns. **Next workstream:** instrument the loop against real CIC-IDS observations + synthetic generator output; measure signature firing rate; measure demotion firing rate per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1.
  - **Methodological observation 1 — Read-only CLI pattern established for F3 orchestrators.** This CLI is the first that reads substrate without ever invoking AppendPair. Mirrors `cmd/list-hypotheses` + `cmd/hypothesis-state` + `cmd/summarize-hypotheses` read-only pattern; differs in that those CLIs project hypothesis state, while this CLI invokes F3 inference. **Pattern: F3 orchestrator CLIs are READ-ONLY over substrate; operator-elected commit happens via existing form-* CLIs after operator reviews candidates.** Future F3 orchestrators (for BehavioralCluster + CampaignHypothesis + CoordinationRing) inherit this pattern.
  - **Methodological observation 2 — Operator-elected commit boundary preserved at orchestrator landing.** [`§0152`](#0152--f3-inference-layer-opens-cdp_marker_density_v1-signature-for-automationgroup-first-camada-a-canonicalaberta-signature-lands-new-signatures-package-establishes-f3-surface) MO2 stated the principle; this entry instantiates it: orchestrator emits candidates; operator commits via existing `form-automation-group`. **Pattern: F3 orchestrator + existing form-* CLI compose to complete the operator-mediated formation path.** Future end-to-end automation (scheduled-job orchestrator that auto-commits) would violate §3 N3 + §0152 discipline; explicit decision-log entry would be required to authorize such a pattern.
  - **Methodological observation 3 — Memory-footprint reversal conditions named.** Current implementation collects all observations into memory before invoking signature. Documented inception-phase acceptable per [`§0023`](#0023--q2-identity-tiers-inceptionphase-singletier-actor_ref-adopted) + [`§0141`](#0141--layer-b-service-tier-implementation-resolution-conservative-defaults-bundle-adopted-a1-internal-package--b1-on-the-fly--c1-substrate-global--d1-transient-demotereport--e1-advisory-like-layer-a--f3-cli-operator-supplied-with-bundled-defaults) F2 conservative-defaults precedent.
    - **R-orch-1: Substrate size pressure** — if substrate grows large enough that O(N) memory footprint becomes infeasible, redesign orchestrator with streaming candidate emission (signature evaluates per window; emits candidates incrementally).
    - **R-orch-2: Multi-signature dispatch** — current orchestrator wires single signature; future may need multi-signature dispatch (compose multiple signatures into one orchestrator invocation). Trigger: second F3 signature lands AND operator workflow requires composite candidate review.
    - **R-orch-3: Cross-modality signature support** — current orchestrator wires BrowserObservation only; future signatures may consume multi-modality input (e.g., Network + Behavioral correlation). Trigger: second-class signature lands with cross-modal consumption requirements.
  - **Methodological observation 4 — JSON output contract decoupled from package-internal representation.** `candidateJSON` + `emissionEnvelope` are CLI-package-local types; `signatures.FormationCandidate` is signatures-package-internal. Operator-facing output evolves at CLI's own cadence; internal signature representation evolves at signatures-package's own cadence. **Pattern: operator-facing serialization contracts decoupled from internal representations for evolution-independence.** Mirrors the canonical-serialization-contract + proto-definitions separation at the substrate layer.

- **Supersession:** No prior decision-log entry superseded. First end-to-end F3 inference loop operationally complete; first orchestrator CLI; subsequent F3 work proceeds under this entry's pattern.

## `0154` — F3 instrumentation pass: EvaluationStats added to Signature interface; per-collector + per-skip-reason counters operational; §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 instrumentation surface

- **Status:** accepted.
- **Date:** 2026-05-24.
- **Context:** [`§0143`](#0143--domain-pack-v01-anti-bot-atlas-framing-pr-opened-first-applied-domain-vertical-on-the-substrate-hybrid-ontologyrevision--operationalspec-rfc-structure) Sub-benchmark 1 criterion mandates instrumentation per subtype × fonte × morfologia-de-chain: "Without this instrumentation, non-firing of benchmarks is non-informative." [`§0152`](#0152--f3-inference-layer-opens-cdp_marker_density_v1-signature-for-automationgroup-first-camada-a-canonicalaberta-signature-lands-new-signatures-package-establishes-f3-surface) landed the signature surface but did not yet expose instrumentation counters at the signature/orchestrator boundary. [`§0153`](#0153--f3-orchestrator-lands-find-automation-group-candidates-cli-wires-signatures-to-substrate-read-path-first-end-to-end-inference-loop-operational) landed the orchestrator with minimal summary output (scanned + candidates). This entry closes the instrumentation gap: introduces `EvaluationStats` + `EvaluationResult` types in signatures package; Signature interface returns `*EvaluationResult` carrying candidates + stats jointly; orchestrator emits stats in JSON output + stderr summary.

  Per §0143 instrumentation-by-source axis: `EvaluationStats.PerCollector` breaks down observation counts by `collector_ref` (§0144 (e) phenomenon-vs-record reconciliation slot). When second ingestion source (synthetic generator OR honeypot collector) lands, the operator can directly observe per-source signature firing rates via the JSON output's `stats.per_collector` field.

- **Decision:** Signatures package refactored to expose instrumentation:

  - **`signatures.EvaluationStats`** struct with counters: ObservationsScanned, ObservationsSkippedNoActor, ObservationsSkippedWrongModality, ActorsAggregated, ActorsAboveThreshold, CandidatesEmitted, PerCollector (map[string]uint32 keyed on `collector_ref`).
  - **`signatures.EvaluationResult`** struct wrapping Candidates + Stats.
  - **`Signature.EvaluateBrowser` interface** changed from `([]*FormationCandidate, error)` to `(*EvaluationResult, error)` — single return value carries both candidates + stats per §0154 design rationale (interface simplicity + instrumentation exposure).
  - **`CDPMarkerDensityV1.EvaluateBrowser` implementation** updated to populate stats during evaluation: increments per-collector counter on observed `collector_ref`; increments per-skip-reason counter on actor_ref-empty or non-cdp-modality; tracks per-actor aggregation count + above-threshold count + emitted count.
  - **`cmd/find-automation-group-candidates` orchestrator** updated to consume `*EvaluationResult` + emit `stats` field in JSON output + extended stderr summary.

  Test additions:
  - `TestCDPMarkerDensityV1_EvaluationStats_PerCollectorBreakdown` (verifies per-collector counter shape across 2 collector_ref namespaces)
  - `TestCDPMarkerDensityV1_EvaluationStats_SkipCounters` (verifies skip counters increment for both no-actor + wrong-modality paths)
  - Orchestrator `TestFullPipeline_EndToEnd` extended with stats-surface verification (ObservationsScanned + ActorsAboveThreshold + CandidatesEmitted + PerCollector).

  Constitutional discipline at instrumentation layer:

  - **§0143 instrumentation-by-source axis** — `PerCollector` map exposes per-source firing rate measurement without forcing callers to pre-enumerate collector_ref namespaces.
  - **§0143 instrumentation-by-subtype axis** — already exposed via `Signature.Subtype()` (signature-level annotation); per-evaluation counters now compose with subtype to give per-subtype × per-source breakdown.
  - **§0143 morfologia-de-chain** — partial surface at signature layer: `EvidenceCount` per candidate is a proxy for chain-breadth-at-root (per-actor source-hash count). Full chain morphology (depth_max, breadth_at_root after formation commit) is substrate-layer observable post-formation-commit; signature-layer captures pre-formation indicators only.
  - **§0143 falsifiability discipline** — with instrumentation, non-firing of Sub-benchmark 1 becomes informative: orchestrator output distinguishes "0 observations scanned" from "N observations scanned, M skipped no actor, K skipped wrong modality, 0 candidates" — diagnostic surface for distinguishing "no observable pattern in input" vs "pattern present but signature insensitive" vs "pattern present + signature sensitive but threshold high".

- **Constitutional review:** No Charter prose modified. No Charter invariant amended. No new Charter invariant.

  Falsifiability discipline: instrumentation behavior structurally observable via the 2 new EvaluationStats tests + extended end-to-end test. Counter increments mechanically checkable per skip path + per collector_ref namespace.

  Backward-compat note: Signature interface signature change is structurally breaking for any external consumer (none exist outside the signatures + orchestrator packages this PR also updates).

- **Consequences:**
  - `signatures.go` extended with `EvaluationStats` + `EvaluationResult` types; `Signature` interface return signature changed.
  - `cdp_marker_density.go` populates EvaluationStats during evaluation.
  - `cdp_marker_density_test.go` extends with 2 new tests + migrates existing 10 tests to new return signature.
  - `cmd/find-automation-group-candidates/main.go` extends emissionEnvelope JSON output with `stats` field + extended stderr summary (actors_aggregated + actors_above_threshold).
  - `cmd/find-automation-group-candidates/main_test.go` extends `TestFullPipeline_EndToEnd` with stats-surface verification.
  - **Sub-benchmark 1 measurement surface complete.** Per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 criterion (first non-trivial demotion in [N] days after F3 mínimo viável; chains-fracas-vs-chains-fortes diagnosis via morphology): the signature-layer instrumentation now exposes the per-evaluation counters needed for the chains-fracas-vs-chains-fortes distinction at evaluation time. Full diagnosis requires substrate-layer chain morphology (post-formation-commit); but signature layer surfaces enough for first-pass diagnosis ("did the signature even see the observation? did it skip it? did the actor accumulate enough evidence?").
  - **Methodological observation 1 — Instrumentation as single return value preserves interface simplicity.** Considered alternative: separate `Signature.Stats()` method returning last-evaluation stats. Rejected because (a) stateful signatures break the stateless-across-invocations contract; (b) callers always want both candidates + stats together. Single `*EvaluationResult` return value carries both atomically. **Pattern: F3 signature interfaces should return a result-struct, not split into multiple methods, when instrumentation is part of the evaluation surface.**
  - **Methodological observation 2 — Per-collector breakdown via map[string]uint32 avoids pre-enumeration.** Considered alternative: typed enum or fixed list of collector_ref namespaces. Rejected because §0144 (e) phenomenon-vs-record reconciliation OMQ explicitly anticipates collector_ref namespaces evolving as new ingestion sources land; pre-enumeration would require proto-definition change per new source. **Pattern: instrumentation surfaces for fields that participate in open-evolution OMQs (collector_ref, future authentication_class extensions) should use string-keyed maps rather than typed enums.**
  - **Methodological observation 3 — Signature-layer instrumentation is partial; full Sub-benchmark 1 measurement requires substrate-layer chain morphology.** EvidenceCount is a proxy; chain_depth_max + chain_breadth_at_root post-formation-commit are the authoritative §0143 morfologia metrics. The substrate-layer surface for these is future work (likely lives in a `cmd/measure-chain-morphology/` or extended `cmd/hypothesis-state/`). **Pattern: instrumentation lands in layers — signature-layer (pre-formation) + substrate-layer (post-formation) compose for full Sub-benchmark 1 measurement.** Future PR completes the substrate-layer half.
  - **Methodological observation 4 — Sub-benchmark 1 non-firing now informative.** Pre-§0154: orchestrator emit "0 candidates" with no diagnostic surface. Post-§0154: orchestrator emit ObservationsScanned + ObservationsSkipped* + ActorsAggregated + PerCollector + CandidatesEmitted, allowing operator to distinguish multiple non-firing causes. **Pattern: instrumentation converts non-firing from uninformative (substrate didn't fire) to diagnostic (substrate observed N events, M skipped for reason X, K signatures fired but none above threshold) — operationalizes §0143 falsifiability discipline.**

- **Supersession:** Signature interface signature change supersedes §0152 + §0153's prior `[]*FormationCandidate` return value. Backward-incompatible for external consumers (none).
